export class PaperClient extends Client {
    commands: Collection<string, CommandType> = new Collection<string, CommandType>()

    private initMoonlink() {

            'LAVALINK_1_PASSWORD',
            'LAVALINK_2_HOST',
            'LAVALINK_2_PORT',
            'LAVALINK_2_PASSWORD'

        const missingVars = requiredEnvVars.filter((varName) => !process.env[varName])

        if (missingVars.length > 0) {
            Logger.warn(
                `蝻箏? Moonlink ?啣?霈: ${missingVars.join(', ')}?oonlink ?撠◤蝳?

import IORedis from 'ioredis'
import { Logger } from '@/libs/utils/logger.js'

export interface CacheClient {
    get(key: string): Promise<string | null>
    setex(key: string, ttlSeconds: number, value: string): Promise<unknown>
    del(key: string): Promise<unknown>
}

class InMemoryCache implements CacheClient {
    private store = new Map<string, { value: string; expireAt: number }>()
    private cleanupInterval: NodeJS.Timeout

    constructor() {
        // 摰?皜????
        this.cleanupInterval = setInterval(() => {
            this.cleanup()
        }, 60000) // 瘥?????甈?    }

    private cleanup(): void {
        const now = Date.now()
        for (const [key, record] of this.store.entries()) {
            if (now > record.expireAt) {
                this.store.delete(key)
            }
        }
    }

    async get(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
        const record = this.store.get(key)
        if (!record) return null

        if (Date.now() > record.expireAt) {
            this.store.delete(key)
            return null
        }

        return record.value
    }

    async setex(key: string, ttlSeconds: number, value: string): Promise<void> {
        this.store.set(key, {
            value,
            expireAt: Date.now() + ttlSeconds * 1000
        })
    }

    async del(key: string): Promise<void> {
        this.store.delete(key)
    }

    // 皜?鞈?
    destroy(): void {
        if (this.cleanupInterval) {
            clearInterval(this.cleanupInterval)
        }
        this.store.clear()
    }
}

// ?寧 factory pattern ?踹??典????class CacheManager {
    private client: CacheClient | null = null
    private isRedisAvailable = true

    private createRedisClient(): CacheClient | null {
        try {
            // ?? import ?踹? require
            const url = process.env.REDIS_URL
            const redis = url ? new IORedis(url) : new IORedis()

            redis.on('error', (err: unknown) => {
                Logger.error('Redis ????航炊:', err)
                this.isRedisAvailable = false
            })

            redis.on('connect', () => {
                Logger.info('Redis ?????')
                this.isRedisAvailable = true
            })

            Logger.info('Redis 摰Ｘ蝡臬歇?萄遣')
            return redis as unknown as CacheClient
        } catch (error) {
            Logger.info('?⊥??萄遣 Redis 摰Ｘ蝡荔?雿輻閮擃翰??)
            this.isRedisAvailable = false
            return null
        }
    }

    getClient(): CacheClient {
        if (!this.client) {
            const redisClient = this.createRedisClient()
            this.client = redisClient || new InMemoryCache()
        }

        // 憒? Redis 銝?剁????啗??園?敹怠?
        if (!this.isRedisAvailable && !(this.client instanceof InMemoryCache)) {
            Logger.info('???啗??園?敹怠?')
            this.client = new InMemoryCache()
        }

        return this.client
    }
}

// ?桐?撖虫?
const cacheManager = new CacheManager()

function getClient(): CacheClient {
    return cacheManager.getClient()
}

export async function cacheSetJsonWithTTL(
    key: string,
    value: unknown,
    ttlSeconds: number
): Promise<void> {
    try {
        const payload = JSON.stringify(value)
        await getClient().setex(key, ttlSeconds, payload)
    } catch (error) {
        Logger.error('敹怠?撖怠憭望?:', error)
        throw error
    }
}

export async function cacheGetJson<T = unknown>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
    try {
        const raw = await getClient().get(key)
        if (!raw) return null

        return JSON.parse(raw) as T
    } catch (error) {
        Logger.error('敹怠?霈?仃??', error)
        return null
    }
}

export async function cacheDel(key: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
        await getClient().del(key)
    } catch (error) {
        Logger.error('敹怠??芷憭望?:', error)
        throw error
    }
}

import CommandUsage from '@/Structures/Schemas/commandUsage.js'
import WeeklyStats from '@/Structures/Schemas/weeklyStats.js'
import type { PipelineStage } from 'mongoose'

export function getMondayStart(date: Date, timezoneOffset = 8) {
    // 頧??啁??
    const local = new Date(date.getTime() + timezoneOffset * 60 * 60 * 1000)

    const day = local.getUTCDay() // 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday
    const diff = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day

    local.setUTCDate(local.getUTCDate() + diff)
    local.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0)

    // 頧? UTC嚗靘踹? DB
    return new Date(local.getTime() - timezoneOffset * 60 * 60 * 1000)
}
